prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production iOS app icon for Mobile Foundry, a native mobile development and GPU interaction catalog.
Primary request: Create one refined, generic abstract icon, sculptural and memorable, with no letters or text.
Subject: a single substantial cobalt-blue continuous folded ribbon, bent into a compact open geometric loop with a clean porcelain negative-space aperture. Three broad bevelled planes turn through depth, suggesting precision, assembly, and motion. The shape must feel coherent and physically crafted, not a tangle or a stock cube. Strong recognizable silhouette at very small app-icon sizes.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D industrial design render, ceramic-coated metal, smooth satin faces, subtle polished bevels. Minimal and calm, with depth conveyed by form and lighting rather than extra decoration.
Composition/framing: square 1024 by 1024 image; centered mark occupying approximately 70% of the canvas with generous safe margins. Very slight isometric perspective, all of the mark visible. Full-bleed solid pale porcelain background #F3F4F6 to every edge. Completely opaque pixels, square outer corners: the operating system supplies the app icon mask.
Lighting/mood: soft upper-left studio light, precise darker blue shaded planes and restrained pale-blue edge reflections, short soft contact shadow. Crisp and high contrast without harsh black shadows.
Color palette: Foundry Studio cobalt #3155C6, deeper blue graphite in shaded parts, pale porcelain #F3F4F6 backdrop. No green, neon, rainbow, or busy gradients.
Constraints: one finished icon, not a mockup or presentation board; no text, initials, typography, border, outer rounded-square tile, watermark, device, flame, hammer, gear, code brackets, or existing brand logo. Avoid tiny details, transparent background, excessive gloss, dramatic glow, thin wires, or floating unrelated pieces.

ios.scope: Default iOS/iPadOS app icon; no separate appearance variants or Icon Composer layers.
